data.jd_text:
**About the Council** 





 The Sharjah Council for Higher Education and Scientific Research (SCHESR) is an advisory body established by Amiri Decree No. (14\) of 2025\. The Council aims to advance the higher education and scientific research ecosystem in the Emirate of Sharjah by promoting quality and excellence standards, fostering integration among higher education institutions, and supporting a research environment that drives innovation and sustainable development. The Council is committed to consolidate the position of the Emirate of Sharjah as a leading scientific hub in the fields of education and knowledge, and as an incubating environment for creativity that contributes to preparing generations capable of keeping pace with future demands.
 




  





**Job Description** 





 The Director of Strategic Planning and Institutional Excellence is responsible for leading and advancing the strategic planning and institutional excellence framework for the higher education sector in the Emirate of Sharjah. The role ensures the alignment of higher education institutions’ plans and initiatives with national development goals and the strategic priorities of the United Arab Emirates. The role oversees the development of academic programs and research capabilities, enhances institutional integration among relevant stakeholders, and advances the data and strategic indicators framework.
 





 Furthermore, the Director leads efforts to leverage advanced analytics and artificial intelligence technologies to support decision\-making, while monitoring institutional and academic performance alongside local and international rankings. This contributes to elevating the quality of education and scientific research outcomes, while strengthening the institutional leadership and competitiveness of higher education institutions across the Emirate of Sharjah.
 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 





 • Lead and develop strategic planning for the higher education sector in alignment with national priorities and the Emirate’s strategic directions.
 





 • Align the strategies of higher education institutions with the Council’s strategic objectives, enhancing coordination and integration among them.
 





 • Develop the academic program frameworks and foster leadership and innovation within higher education.
 





 • Support the growth and development of academic and research talent to elevate the overall quality of education and scientific research.
 





 • Oversee the management of institutional data and analytics, leveraging them to support policy formulation and decision\-making.
 





 • Monitor performance indicators and benchmark rankings to boost the competitiveness of higher education institutions.
 




  





**Qualifications** 





 • Master’s degree or Ph.D. in Strategic Planning in Education, Higher Education Management, Policy and Leadership in Education or any related field.
 




  





**Experience Required** 





 • Minimum of 15 years of experience in strategic planning, higher education management, educational policy development, or a related field.
 




  





**Skills and Competencies** 





 • High leadership and management skills with the ability to lead and motivate teams to achieve strategic objectives.
 





 • Proven experience in strategic planning, policy formulation, and development initiatives within the higher education sector.
 





 • Ability to analyze institutional data and indicators to extract actionable recommendations that support decision\-making.
 





 • In\-depth knowledge of global trends and best practices in higher education and scientific research.
 





 • Advanced skills in project management and tracking the execution of strategic initiatives. strategic initiatives.
 





 • Ability to build partnerships and coordinate effectively with higher education institutions and relevant key stakeholders.
 





 • Strong skills in preparing studies, reports, executive presentations, and submitting recommendations to senior management.
 





 • Exceptional communication, presentation, and persuasion skills in both Arabic and English.
 





 • Ability to work effectively in a dynamic environment and manage priorities effectively.
 





 • Proficiency in utilizing analytical tools, reporting systems, performance management frameworks, and strategic indicators.
 




  





**Location** 





 Emirate of Sharjah, UAE

Qiddiya Investment Company is transforming the entertainment landscape in Saudi Arabia, and we are in search of a strategic and commercially driven professional to fill the role of Director \- Development Financial Planning within our Sports Business Unit. This position is pivotal in shaping our development strategy through comprehensive business planning, financial strategy, and commercial analysis for proposed world\-class sports assets and facilities, with total investment value exceeding several billion dollars.
   

  

 As the Director of Development Financial Planning \- Sports, you will be responsible for establishing the strategic direction and commercial framework for various sports development projects. You will lead a high\-performing team that develops comprehensive business plans, investment strategies, and financial models while serving as a key member of the senior leadership team. Your role will be instrumental in driving investment decisions, optimizing capital allocation, and ensuring our projects deliver exceptional returns while aligning with Qiddiya's long\-term vision.
   

  

 Day to day you will be partnering with C\-suite executives, development leaders, strategy teams and key stakeholders to shape the future of world\-class sports assets and facilities. With that in mind, outstanding commercial acumen, strategic leadership, and the ability to influence at the highest levels are essential, while experience in large\-scale sporting events and venues would be beneficial given the role's strategic focus.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Establish and oversee the strategic planning function for the Sports Business Unit, including development of investment strategies, business plans, and financial frameworks for multiple billion\-dollar development projects
* Drive capital optimization and investment strategy, ensuring sophisticated financial modeling and strategic assessment of all investments while maximizing shareholder value
* Lead the development of innovative commercial models and revenue strategies for sports assets in collaboration with senior leadership teams
* Direct complex feasibility studies and strategic assessments for major development initiatives, including guidance on capital structure, funding options, and risk management strategies
* Foster strategic relationships with key stakeholders, financial institutions, and partners to drive business growth and secure optimal financing solutions
* Spearhead transformation initiatives in financial and commercial strategy to ensure executive decision making is based on best\-in\-class analysis and thinking
* Lead strategic due diligence and valuation of potential investments, partnerships, and development opportunities
* Develop and implement sophisticated financial planning and analysis frameworks to drive strategic decision\-making at board level
* Guide long\-term financial forecasting and scenario planning to optimize portfolio performance and returns
* Direct the creation of board\-level business cases and investment proposals, including detailed ROI analysis and risk assessment
* Establish best practices in business planning and financial strategy across the organization
* Lead change management initiatives to improve financial planning processes and drive operational excellence


**Requirements**
* Bachelor's degree in finance, economics, real estate, or a related field
* A minimum of 15\-18 years of relevant experience,
* Early experience at a leading management consultancy and subsequent operational or client\-side roles are preferred but not mandatory
* Proven track record of leading financial strategy and business planning for large\-scale development projects ($1B\+)
* Experience in financial planning and business strategy for major sporting venues or events is highly desirable
* Demonstrated expertise in capital markets, project finance, and investment strategy
* Strong background in developing and implementing commercial frameworks and revenue optimization strategies
* Distinguished expertise in business planning, financial modeling, and strategic analysis for complex development projects
* Exceptional critical thinking and strategic problem\-solving abilities, with demonstrated capability to drive innovation and challenge conventional approaches
* Outstanding executive presence and communication skills, with proven ability to influence and engage at board and C\-suite levels
* Strong leadership capabilities, with demonstrated success in building and developing high\-performing teams
* Advanced proficiency in financial modeling, strategic planning tools, and enterprise\-level planning systems

data.jd_text:
Position: Director of Global Excellence and Benchmarking
   

  

 Classification: Senior Administrative and Academic Leadership\- Director Level
   

  

 Reports To: President
   

  

**About The American International University**
 American International University (AIU) is a private institution in Kuwait, founded in 2019, offering undergraduate programs based on the American model of higher education. AIU provides degrees in Engineering, Architecture and Design, Business Administration, Arts and Sciences, and Education, with English as the language of instruction. The University is committed to fostering intellectual, cultural, and personal growth, preparing graduates for leadership roles in a global society.
   

  

 AIU is executing its RISE Strategy 2026–2030, a five\-year institutional transformation encompassing research development, international institutional accreditation, student success, and community engagement. A central strategic objective is establishing AIU's presence in international university rankings and benchmarking its performance against regional and global peers. The Director of Global Excellence and Benchmarking leads this agenda.
   

  

 For more information, visit: www.aiu.edu.kw
   

  

 Department Profile
   

  

 The Office of Global Excellence and Benchmarking is a newly established function reporting directly to the President. It serves as AIU's strategic intelligence unit, transforming institutional data into rankings entries, competitive intelligence into positioning decisions, and benchmarking evidence into actionable improvement plans. The Office works in close partnership with the Institutional Research (IR) Office, the Accreditation \& Institutional Effectiveness Office, the AVP Research \& Innovation, and the Vice President for Academic Affairs.
   

  

 This office is AIU's external face to the global higher education community, responsible for ensuring that AIU's institutional quality is visible, accurately measured, and credibly communicated to every ranking body, benchmark framework, and peer institution that matters to AIU's reputation and competitive position.
   

  

 Scope of Work:
   

  

 The Director of Global Excellence and Benchmarking is responsible for designing, implementing, and managing AIU's comprehensive strategy for international university rankings and institutional benchmarking. This is a hands\-on, data\-intensive, externally\-facing role that requires deep technical knowledge of ranking methodologies, the analytical rigor to translate raw institutional data into ranking submissions, and the strategic vision to identify where AIU can achieve measurable improvement across ranking indicators.
   

  

 The role encompasses three interconnected domains:
   

  

* Rankings Strategy \& Submission: Lead all data submissions to QS, THE, Webometrics, UI GreenMetric, and other ranking bodies, with full technical mastery of each agency's methodology, data definitions, and submission portals.
* Institutional Benchmarking: Systematically benchmark AIU's performance against Kuwait and regional peer institutions, and global aspirational peers, producing actionable competitive intelligence for the President.
* Reputation \& Visibility: Build AIU's academic reputation through strategic visibility, Scopus profile management, Webometrics optimisation, academic survey response coordination, and employer survey engagement for ranking systems reputation scores.


 Key Responsibilities:
   

  

 Rankings Strategy and Data Submission
   

  

* Develop and maintain AIU's annual Rankings Action Plan, a structured, data\-driven roadmap for improving position across all active and target ranking systems, updated each October for Board review
* Manage all data submissions to QS World University Rankings, QS Stars, Times Higher Education (THE) World and Impact Rankings, Webometrics Ranking of World Universities, and UI GreenMetric, ensuring submissions are complete, accurate, and filed before agency deadlines
* Maintain detailed, up\-to\-date knowledge of the methodology, data definitions, indicators, and weighting of every active ranking system in AIU's portfolio; monitor changes to methodology and adjust data strategy accordingly
* Build and maintain the AIU Rankings Data Repository, the single authoritative source of record for all data submitted to external ranking agencies, maintained in a format that enables year\-on\-year comparison and audit
* Coordinate with the Institutional Research Office, Registrar, Library, HR, and VP Academic Affairs to collect, verify, and validate all data elements required for ranking submissions
* Ensure that all data submitted to ranking agencies is accurate, reproducible, and consistent with data published on AIU's public website, no figure may be submitted to a ranking body that cannot be independently verified


 Institutional Benchmarking and Competitive Intelligence
   

  

* Design and implement an annual benchmarking programme comparing AIU's performance against defined peer groups across Kuwait, the GCC, and internationally, covering student outcomes, faculty productivity, research output, employability, and student\-to\-faculty ratios
* Produce the Annual Benchmarking Report for the President, a structured, visual, decision\-ready analysis showing AIU's relative position, trajectory, and priority improvement areas
* Monitor peer institution rankings, accreditation status, programme offerings, and strategic developments, providing the President with quarterly competitive intelligence briefs
* Identify the specific ranking indicators where AIU has the highest potential for near\-term improvement and develop targeted action plans in coordination with the relevant VP or Dean
* Represent AIU's position accurately in all external comparisons and marketing materials, ensuring no benchmarking claim is made without verified, methodologically sound data


 Academic Reputation and Visibility
   

  

* Lead AIU's response to the QS and THE academic reputation surveys, coordinating with the President, VPAA, and Deans to identify and engage Kuwaiti, GCC, and international academics who are familiar with AIU's work
* Lead AIU's response to the QS employer reputation survey, working with VP Engagement \& External Relations and Career Services to engage Kuwait and GCC employers who hire AIU graduates
* Manage and continuously improve AIU's Webometrics profile, overseeing institutional web presence, digital publication of research outputs, and online visibility of faculty and research activity
* Work with the AVP Research \& Innovation to ensure all AIU research publications are indexed in Scopus and Web of Science under the correct institutional affiliation, preventing data loss that would otherwise cost AIU citation metrics
* Manage AIU's institutional profiles on all ranking agency platforms, QS Top Universities, THE World University Rankings, Scopus Institutions, Google Scholar, keeping information current and complete


 Strategy Alignment and Internal Reporting
   

  

* Serve as the primary point of contact between AIU and all ranking agencies, maintaining professional relationships with QS, THE, and Webometrics account managers
* Present the Annual Rankings Progress Report to the Board of Trustees alongside the RISE Strategy KPI review, demonstrating measurable movement on ranking indicators
* Advise the President, VPAA, and Deans on the ranking implications of institutional decisions, including faculty hiring, research investment, program development, and student recruitment strategy
* Coordinate with the Accreditation Liaison Officer to ensure that ranking data submissions are consistent with WSCUC self\-study data, no gap or contradiction between accreditation and ranking evidence
* Contribute to the Annual Institutional Effectiveness Report the rankings and benchmarking.
* Train and brief faculty, administrators, and Deans on ranking methodologies, what each indicator measures, and what faculty behavior, particularly in research and publication directly affects AIU's ranking position


 Reporting Departments (If Applicable)
   

  

 Minimum Qualifications:
   

  

 Education
   

  

* Terminal degree (PhD or equivalent doctorate) from an accredited institution, preferably in higher education management, educational measurement, data science, institutional research, information science, or a related field
* Master's degree holders with exceptional and directly relevant ranking agency experience may be considered at the discretion of the President


**Experience**
* Minimum five (5\) years of progressive experience in higher education, with a demonstrable track record in institutional research, rankings management, or data analytics in a university context
* Directly demonstrated experience submitting data to at least two of the following ranking agencies: QS World University Rankings, Times Higher Education Rankings, Webometrics, or UI GreenMetric, applications must specify which agencies and provide verifiable submission history
* Experience in competitive benchmarking and peer analysis in an academic or strategic planning context
* Experience working with senior academic leadership, President, Provost, or equivalent, and presenting data\-driven findings to Board\-level audiences


 Technical Knowledge
   

  

* Deep, current knowledge of QS, THE, Webometrics, and UI GreenMetric ranking methodologies, including indicator definitions, data sources, weighting systems, and common submission errors
* Proficiency with bibliometric and citation databases: Scopus, Web of Science, and Google Scholar, ability to extract, verify, and analyse institutional publication and citation data
* Strong data analytics capability, experience with Excel, Power BI, Tableau, or equivalent tools; ability to build ranking dashboards and data visualisations for executive audiences
* Familiarity with Student Information Systems (SIS), LMS data extraction, and IPEDS\-equivalent international data standards
* Knowledge of WSCUC or equivalent regional accreditation standards and the relationship between accreditation evidence and ranking indicators is a significant advantage


 Skills and Competencies
   

  

* Exceptional data integrity standards, this role requires someone who treats accuracy as non\-negotiable: no figure submitted to a ranking body may be inaccurate, and no publicly stated benchmark may be unverified
* Excellent written and oral communication in English, ability to translate complex methodological data into clear, compelling narratives for Board members with no prior knowledge of ranking systems
* Strong project management capability, ability to manage multiple concurrent ranking submission timelines, each with fixed external deadlines
* Cultural awareness and professional sophistication appropriate to representing AIU to international ranking agencies and academic communities
* Arabic language proficiency is an advantage but is not required


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Prior experience in a GCC university in a rankings, institutional research, or strategic planning role, familiarity with Kuwait's higher education regulatory context is a significant advantage
* Experience with QS Stars institutional rating system, which AIU is targeting in the near term
* Experience developing an institutional rankings strategy from a baseline position, candidates who have built a rankings programme at a new or young institution are particularly sought
* Published research or professional presentations on university rankings methodology, higher education data quality, or institutional benchmarking
* Familiarity with Kuwait Vision 2035 and its implications for higher education quality and international competitiveness


 How to Apply
   

  

 Interested candidates should visit the Job Opportunities section on the AIU website and submit a complete application comprising:
   

  

* A current curriculum vitae (CV)
* A cover letter (maximum 2 pages) explaining: (a) your experience submitting data to specific ranking agencies, name the agencies and describe your role; (b) a specific example of a benchmarking or ranking improvement you contributed to; and (c) why this role at AIU at this stage of its development is the right next step in your career
* Contact details for three professional referees at least one of whom supervised your ranking or institutional research work


 Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis until the position is filled. The University reserves the right to close the search at any time. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
   

  

 Submit application via: https://aiu.edu.kw/careers/jobs
   

  

 The successful candidate is expected to commence employment at the earliest convenience, and no later than September 2026\.
   

  

 AIU is an equal opportunity employer committed to academic excellence, professional integrity,
   

  

 and the advancement of Kuwait as a regional center of knowledge and innovation.

data.jd_text:
**About Moove**
 Moove is one of the world's fastest\-growing mobility infrastructure companies.
   

  

 We finance and supply vehicles to mobility platforms across Africa, the Middle East, Asia, and Latin America and we're building the infrastructure layer that the next generation of mobility will depend on. The company is pre\-IPO, operating at scale across multiple geographies, and moving through one of the most consequential phases of its growth.
   

  

 The pace is fast and the stakes are high. The decisions being made now will define the company for a decade. We are building the next phase of this business to be AI\-native from the ground up and the people around the leadership table need to be operating at their best.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Director of Strategy \& Operations serves as a trusted partner to the Co\-CEO and President, ensuring that ambitious growth plans are executable, aligned, and supported across the organisation. The role will be crucial in operationalizing the vision of Moove.
   

  

 On the execution side, this role owns the operating rhythm of the leadership team, converts strategic direction into clear accountabilities, and ensures decisions are structured, actioned, and embedded across business units. On the strategic side, the Director of Strategy \& Operations researches and constructs long\-term corporate strategy, embeds governance and decision rights, and provides forward\-looking scenario analysis to feed into any corporate planning.
   

  

 Because much of the company’s operating infrastructure is still being built, this role carries significant build responsibility. The Director of Strategy \& Operations will design the ways of working, stand up performance frameworks, and embed the OKR and scorecard systems through which the business runs. This is an execution role with strategic range, the ratio matters, and the ceiling is high.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**
 Strategy and Governance
   

  

* Research, construct, and support the development of long\-term corporate strategy in partnership with the Co\-CEO and President; ensure it is cascaded into business unit priorities through structured communication channels including town halls, leadership briefings, and BU\-level planning.
* Operationalise the operating model, ensuring business units are aligned, accountable, and able to deliver against growth priorities
* Guide the decentralisation effort, embedding governance structures and clear decision rights across business units
* Partner with senior functional leaders to identify and close capability gaps that impact business performance
* Provide forward\-looking scenario analysis to feed into future strategy


 Operating Rhythm and Execution
   

  

* Own the executive operating rhythm, leadership meetings, offsites, board and committee reviews, ensuring decisions are structured, actioned, and embedded
* Translate strategic direction into clear actions, owners, and timelines across the organisation; hold stakeholders accountable to commitments
* Identify and remove blockers; drive stalled decisions to resolution with pace and rigour
* Facilitate integration across functions and business units, aligning resources and priorities to avoid silos
* Identify and escalate risks that may impact business performance or growth, ensuring mitigation plans are in place


 Performance and Organizational Effectiveness
   

  

* Embed OKRs and business performance scorecards in collaboration with the People Team; provide data\-driven insights to the Co\-CEO and executive team to inform decisions
* Ensure business performance outcomes are supported by aligned people performance priorities
* Manage information flow to and from the Co\-CEO, surface what requires attention and filter what does not


**Strategic Outputs**
* Prepare and own high\-stakes outputs: board materials, investor updates, strategic documents, and executive briefings
* Lead specific strategic and operational workstreams directly when required, including platform development and capital markets preparation
* Identify and deploy AI tools and workflows to increase the velocity and quality of the Co\-CEO’s office


**Experience**
**What You will need for this position**
* 6–10 years of experience owning outcomes in high\-growth or high\-complexity environments
* Prior experience as a Chief of Staff, Director of Strategy \& Operations, COO, or senior operator at a high\-velocity technology company, or equivalent seniority from top\-tier strategy consulting with demonstrated operational delivery
* Experience building or running a critical function through a period of rapid growth, transformation, or M\&A activity
* Demonstrable track record of closing things, decisions, commitments, workstreams, at pace and without loss of quality


**Skills And Capabilities**
* Exceptional written communication; produces board\-quality documents, strategic memos, and executive briefings independently
* Ability to process complexity quickly, communicate it clearly, and operate with minimal direction
* Genuinely AI\-native; uses AI to increase personal and team velocity, with experience managing AI\-enabled workflows or operating system design
* Sufficient fluency across technology, capital markets, and business transformation to engage credibly across Moove’s active workstreams
* Strong product and technology instincts; understands how software is built, how platforms scale, and how technology and physical operations intersect
* Sound judgment on when to act independently and when to escalate
* Available across geographies and time zones as required


**What Does Success Look Like**
* The Co\-CEO and President’s office operates as a high\-performance execution engine, no decisions stall, no commitments drop
* The company’s operating cadence is designed, implemented, and running effectively within the first 90 days
* OKRs and performance scorecards are embedded and generating actionable insights for the executive team
* Governance structures and decision rights are documented and operational across all business units
* Board and investor outputs are produced on time, to a consistently high standard
* Strategic workstreams move faster and with greater clarity as a direct result of this role’s involvement


**Who You'll Be Working with:**
 Directly reporting to our CO\-CEO \& President, and closely working with our office of the CEO team.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Our team is collaborative, positive, curious, and engaged. We think fast, work smart, laugh often, and are looking for like\-minded people to join us in our mission to disrupt vehicle ownership and make financial freedom within reach.
   

  

 Moove is strongly committed to diversity within its community. The Company’s approved Employment Equity Plan and Targets will be considered as part of the recruitment process. As an Equal Opportunities employer, we welcome people from all backgrounds who seek the opportunity to help build a future where everyone and everything can move independently.
   

  

**Pre\-hiring Notice:** 
 Moove relies on the accuracy of information contained in employment applications, as well as the accuracy of other data presented throughout the hiring process and during employment. Any misrepresentations, falsifications, or material omissions in any information or data provided by an applicant may result in the applicant being excluded from further consideration for employment or if an individual has already been hired, termination of employment.
   

  

**EEO Statement:** 
 Moove is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of gender, race, sexual orientation, marital status, religion, political affiliation or any other protected characteristic.

data.jd_text:
Position: Chief Information Officer (CIO)
   

  

 Classification: Senior Leadership
   

  

 Reports To: President
   

  

**About The American International University**
 American International University (AIU) is a private institution in Kuwait, founded in 2019, offering undergraduate programs based on the American model of higher education. AIU provides degrees in Engineering, Architecture and Design, Business Administration, Arts and Sciences, and Education, with English as the language of instruction. The University is committed to fostering intellectual, cultural, and personal growth, preparing graduates for leadership roles in a global society.
   

  

 AIU is in active execution of its RISE Strategy 2026–2030, a five\-year institutional transformation anchored in research development, WSCUC international accreditation, student success, and community engagement. Technology is not peripheral to this strategy; it is foundational to it. The CIO is a key member of the Senior Leadership Team, responsible for ensuring that AIU's digital infrastructure, enterprise platforms, and data ecosystem are built for the institutional ambitions of 2030, not the operational needs of 2019\.
   

  

 For more information, visit: www.aiu.edu.kw
   

  

 Department Profile
   

  

 The CIO oversees two integrated functions that together constitute AIU's technology enterprise: the established Information Technology division, led by the Executive Director of IT, and the newly created Digital Transformation Office, which sits directly under the CIO's strategic leadership. Together, these functions manage all enterprise platforms, cybersecurity and data governance, academic technology, digital student services, and the AI\-enabled tools that support administrative decision\-making.
   

  

 Scope of Work
   

  

 The Chief Information Officer serves as AIU's most senior technology executive and a strategic thought partner to the President. The role bridges two realities: managing a live and growing enterprise technology environment reliably and efficiently today, while building the digital infrastructure that will sustain a WASC\-accredited, research\-active, rankings\-visible university by 2030\. The CIO is accountable for both.
   

  

 The scope of work spans five interconnected domains:
   

  

* IT Strategy \& Governance: Define and execute the multi\-year IT strategic plan aligned with the RISE Strategy. Own IT governance, policy, and investment decisions across the entire technology portfolio.
* Campus Digital Transformation: Lead the systematic replacement of manual, SharePoint, and Excel\-based processes with integrated, automated, data\-driven systems across administration, academics, research, and student services.
* Enterprise Platform Management: Oversee the optimization, integration, and lifecycle management of all enterprise platforms: Banner (SIS), Canvas (LMS), Salesforce (CRM), Oracle Finance, and Tableau and lead evaluation of next\-generation systems.
* AI \& Data Intelligence: Champion the institutional adoption of AI tools and data analytics to enhance administration efficiency, student success, research support, and decision\-making at every level of the University.
* Cybersecurity \& Data Governance: Ensure AIU's data is secure, accurate, accessible, and compliant providing the data infrastructure that WASC accreditation, institutional research, and Board reporting require.


 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* IT Strategy, Governance and Presidential Advisory
* Serve as the President's primary technology advisor translating institutional strategic objectives into technology investment decisions, capability roadmaps, and implementation sequencing
* Develop, own, and execute AIU's multi\-year Technology Strategic Plan, updated annually and aligned with the RISE Strategy 2026–2030 KPIs and the WSCUC accreditation evidence requirements
* Establish and chair the AIU Technology Governance Committee a cross\-functional body including the VPAA, VP Administration \& Finance, VP Enrollment, and Faculty Council representative to set institutional technology priorities and resolve competing demands on IT resources
* Present quarterly technology performance reports to the President and an annual technology state\-of\-institution report to the Board of Trustees in plain language, not technical language
* Manage the IT budget with full accountability for return on investment: technology spend must be justified by measurable institutional outcomes, not by technical preference
* Lead all major technology vendor selection, contract negotiation, and relationship management ensuring AIU obtains best\-value agreements and maintains leverage with strategic technology partners
* Campus Digital Transformation
* Conduct a comprehensive Digital Readiness Audit in the first 90 days mapping every major administrative and academic workflow against its current technology support level. identifying all critical processes still running on low level manual folders, email chains, or papers.
* Develop and execute a phased Digital Transformation Roadmap that systematically replaces manual and disconnected processes with integrated, automated, role\-appropriate digital workflows prioritized by institutional impact and WSCUC accreditation urgency
* Lead the digitalization of Student Journey processes from application and admission through advising, registration, assessment, career services, and alumni engagement ensuring every student interaction is trackable, data\-rich, and continuously improvable
* Drive the digitalization of Faculty and Research workflows including research output tracking, grant management, assessment data collection, course file management, and faculty performance documentation
* Ensure all digital transformation initiatives are adopted effectively change management, training, and user support are as important as the technology itself; a system that faculty and staff do not use has delivered zero value
* Coordinate with the Director of Global Excellence and Benchmarking to ensure that institutional data required for QS, THE, and Webometrics submissions is generated automatically by integrated systems rather than assembled manually each year
* Enterprise Platform Optimization and Integration
* Maximize the institutional value of AIU's existing enterprise platform investments: Banner (SIS), Canvas (LMS), Salesforce (CRM), Oracle Finance, and Tableau.
* Design and implement a unified integration architecture so that data flows seamlessly and automatically between systems eliminating manual data re\-entry, reducing data errors, and creating the single source of truth the institutional research function requires
* Evaluate, recommend, and lead the procurement of any new enterprise platforms required by the RISE Strategy including student success platforms, research management systems, data warehouse solutions, and AI tooling
* Ensure that all platform implementations are executed to full functional scope with proper data governance, user training, and long\-term support plans partial implementations that leave core functionality unused are not acceptable outcomes
* Lead the migration of institutional data from SharePoint folders and Excel workbooks into appropriate managed systems with documented data governance, access controls, version management, and audit trails
* Artificial Intelligence and Data Intelligence
* Develop and implement AIU's Artificial Intelligence Strategy a practical, phased plan for deploying AI tools across administration, academic operations, student services, and research support that delivers measurable efficiency gains and quality improvements
* Lead the deployment of AI\-enhanced analytics and reporting so that the President, VPAA, Deans, and Department Chairs have real\-time, dashboard\-based visibility into the institutional metrics that matter enrollment trends, retention signals, research output, financial position without waiting for manual report compilation
* Implement AI\-powered student success tools early alert systems, predictive retention models, personalized advising recommendations that enable the institution to intervene proactively with at\-risk students rather than reactively after they withdraw
* Develop and enforce an institutional AI Acceptable Use Policy covering responsible use of generative AI in instruction, assessment, research, and administration balancing innovation with academic integrity and data privacy
* Stay at the forefront of AI developments in higher education and advise the President and academic leadership on which emerging tools are ready for institutional adoption, which require further evaluation, and which present risks that outweigh their benefits
* Build internal AI capability ensuring that faculty, administrators, and student\-facing staff are trained to use AI tools appropriately and that AIU does not become dependent on vendors for capability that should be developed in\-house
* Cybersecurity, Data Governance and WASC Compliance
* Establish and maintain a risk\-based information security program aligned with ISO/IEC 27001 and NIST frameworks appropriate to AIU's scale, risk profile, and budget protecting student, faculty, staff, and institutional data
* Develop and enforce data governance standards across all institutional systems defining data ownership, data quality standards, access controls, retention schedules, and the single\-source\-of\-truth principles that eliminate contradictory data across departments
* Ensure that the data infrastructure required for WSCUC accreditation is reliable, reproducible, and audit\-ready no accreditation submission may be built on data that cannot be independently verified from a managed system
* Implement and maintain business continuity and disaster recovery plans for all mission\-critical systems ensuring AIU can maintain academic and administrative operations through system failures, cybersecurity incidents, or other disruptions
* Ensure compliance with Kuwait data protection requirements and any applicable international standards including student record privacy, financial data security, and research data management
* Oversee AIU's cybersecurity incident response capability ensuring that the institution can detect, contain, and recover from security incidents rapidly and with minimal impact to operations
* Leadership, Team Development and Vendor Management
* Provide strategic leadership and executive oversight to the Executive Director of Information Technology and the Digital Transformation Office setting clear direction, performance expectations, and development pathways for the technology team
* Build and maintain a high\-performing technology organization recruiting, developing, and retaining talented technology professionals in a competitive Kuwait market, and creating a culture of service excellence, continuous improvement, and innovation
* Manage all technology vendor relationships at the executive level ensuring that strategic partners are held to their contractual commitments, that technology contracts are reviewed and optimized regularly, and that AIU's vendor ecosystem remains coherent and manageable
* Represent AIU in relevant higher education technology networks, conferences, and professional forums maintaining awareness of best practice and building relationships that can benefit the institution


 Reporting Departments (If Applicable)
   

  

* Executive Director of Information Technology: day\-to\-day IT operations, helpdesk, infrastructure, and enterprise platform administration
* Digital Transformation Office Director: program management for all transformation initiatives, process automation, and workflow digitalization
* Cybersecurity \& Data Governance Lead: information security, data governance standards, and compliance


 Minimum Qualifications:
   

  

 Education
   

  

* Doctorate (PhD) in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or a closely related field strongly preferred
* Master's degree in a relevant discipline required as a minimum; candidates with a master's and exceptional, directly relevant GCC higher education CIO experience will be considered


**Experience**
* Minimum ten (10\) years of progressive technology leadership experience, with at least five (5\) years at CIO, Deputy CIO, or equivalent executive level in a higher education institution
* Demonstrated experience leading campus digital transformation, specifically the transition of institutional processes from manual, Excel, and SharePoint\-based workflows to integrated, automated enterprise systems
* Proven track record in selecting, implementing, and optimizing enterprise university platforms, particularly Banner (SIS), Canvas (LMS), Salesforce (CRM), Oracle or equivalent ERP, and business intelligence tools
* Experience building and executing AI strategies in an institutional or enterprise context, not theoretical familiarity with AI, but demonstrated deployment of AI tools that delivered measurable operational improvements
* Experience working in GCC higher education is a significant advantage, candidates with UAE, Kuwait, Saudi Arabia, or comparable Gulf university CIO experience are strongly preferred
* Experience managing technology in a context of accreditation preparation, WASC, AACSB, ABET, or comparable quality assurance framework, is a substantial advantage


 Technical Knowledge
   

  

* Deep proficiency with higher education enterprise platforms: Ellucian Banner or equivalent SIS, Canvas or comparable LMS, Salesforce or equivalent CRM, Oracle Fusion/EBS or equivalent ERP, Tableau or equivalent BI
* Cloud architecture and management expertise: Azure, AWS, or GCP, including IaaS, PaaS, SaaS governance, cloud migration strategy, and hybrid infrastructure management
* AI and machine learning application: practical experience deploying AI tools in an institutional setting, student success analytics, process automation, natural language processing, or predictive modelling
* Cybersecurity governance: demonstrated knowledge of ISO/IEC 27001, NIST frameworks, and risk\-based security program management, including incident response and business continuity planning
* Data governance and integration: experience designing data governance frameworks, master data management standards, and system integration architectures that eliminate data silos
* DevOps and automation: familiarity with modern DevOps practices, RPA tools, and workflow automation platforms that reduce manual administrative workload


 Leadership and Interpersonal Competencies
   

  

* The ability to translate complex technology concepts into clear business and strategic language for Board members, the President, Deans, and faculty, technology leadership at the C\-suite level is fundamentally a communication role
* Demonstrated change management capability, the ability to lead people through technology\-driven organizational change with empathy, clarity, and persistence
* Service\-oriented leadership: AIU's IT function exists to serve students, faculty, and staff, the CIO must model and build a culture where the technology team measures its success by the outcomes it enables, not the systems it manages
* Executive\-level stakeholder engagement: the CIO sits on the Senior Leadership Team and must be an effective, credible peer contributor to institutional strategy discussions that extend beyond technology


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Prior CIO or Deputy CIO experience at a GCC university, with working knowledge of Kuwait's higher education regulatory environment and PUC data requirements
* Experience with Ellucian Banner Cloud migration, AIU's Banner environment will require cloud migration planning within the strategy period
* Published research or professional thought leadership on AI in higher education, digital transformation in universities, or cybersecurity in academic environments
* Bilingual proficiency in English and Arabic, strong written and oral English is mandatory; Arabic is a significant advantage for stakeholder engagement with Kuwait government bodies and Arabic\-speaking staff and students
* Experience managing a greenfield or rapid\-growth university technology environment AIU's pace of institutional development requires a CIO comfortable with building and scaling, not just maintaining
* Experience integrating WASC or comparable accreditation data requirements into enterprise system design ensuring that accreditation evidence is a by\-product of normal institutional operations, not an annual emergency


 How to Apply
   

  

 Interested candidates should visit the Job Opportunities section on the AIU website and submit a complete application comprising:
   

  

* A current curriculum vitae
* A cover letter (maximum 3 pages) addressing three specific questions: (1\) Describe a campus digital transformation initiative you personally led what was the starting state, what did you build, and how do you measure its success? (2\) Describe your most significant AI deployment in an institutional setting the problem it solved, the tools used, and the measurable outcome. (3\) What is your 90\-day plan for the CIO role at AIU, given the context described in this advertisement?
* A brief technology leadership portfolio or case study (optional but encouraged) 2–4 pages demonstrating a specific transformation, platform implementation, or strategic technology decision you led
* Contact details for three professional referees, at least two of whom directly supervised your CIO or senior IT leadership work


 Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. The University reserves the right to close the search at any time. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. Shortlisted candidates will be invited for a structured interview process including a technology strategy presentation to the President and Senior Leadership Team.
   

  

 Submit applications via: https://aiu.edu.kw/careers/jobs
   

  

 The successful candidate is expected to commence employment at the earliest convenience.

**Company Description** 
 Oman Fiber Optic (OFO), established in 1996, is a leading fiber cable manufacturer based in Muscat. The company began cable production in 1999 and utilizes state\-of\-the\-art technology to draw fiber and produce high\-quality fiber cable products. OFO serves regional and international markets with world\-class solutions that support modern telecommunications and connectivity.
 



  





**Role Purpose:** 
 Responsible for managing and overseeing the daily operations of the CEO Office while supporting strategic initiatives, corporate governance, executive coordination, and business performance follow\-up. The position acts as a key liaison between the CEO, executive management, and internal/external stakeholders to ensure effective execution of strategic priorities and organizational objectives.
 



  





**Role Description** 




**Executive Office Management:** 



* Manage and coordinate all activities within the CEO Office efficiently and professionally.
* Handle the CEO’s calendar, meetings, business travel, appointments, and confidential correspondence.
* Prepare executive presentations, reports, dashboards, and briefing materials for meetings and Board discussions.
* Ensure proper follow\-up on CEO directives, action plans, and strategic initiatives across departments.
* Monitor deadlines and ensure timely completion of assigned tasks and projects.



**Strategic \& Business Support:** 



* Support the CEO in tracking the company’s strategic objectives, KPIs, and business performance.
* Coordinate with department heads to follow up on strategic projects and initiatives.
* Assist in preparing corporate strategy reports, business reviews, and executive summaries.
* Participate in strategic planning sessions and management meetings.
* Analyze business data and prepare insights to support executive decision\-making.
* Ensure alignment between operational activities and corporate strategy.
* Communication \& Stakeholder Management:
* Act as the main coordination point between the CEO and internal employees.
* Draft professional communications, announcements, and executive correspondence.
* Handle sensitive and confidential matters with high professionalism and discretion.
* Build strong working relationships across all organizational levels.



**Project \& Performance Follow\-Up:** 



* Track progress of key corporate projects and provide regular status updates to the CEO.
* Coordinate cross\-functional initiatives led by the CEO Office.
* Identify delays, risks, and gaps in project execution and escalate when required.



  
 



**Qualifications** 



* Bachelor’s Degree in Business Administration, Management, Strategic Management, Human Resources, Finance, or related field.
* Bachelor’s degree or professional certifications is an advantage.
* Minimum 5–8 years of experience in executive office management, corporate strategy, executive coordination, or business management roles.
* Experience working directly with CEOs, executive management, or Board members is highly preferred.
* Experience in strategic planning, performance management, or corporate governance is an advantage.
* Professional in excel, PowerPoint and AI tools



  





**Key Competencies** 



* Attention to Detail
* Time Management
* Executive Presence
* Business Acumen
* Strategic Thinking
* Corporate Communication
* Negotiation \& Influencing
* Relationship Building
* Problem Solving
* Decision Support
* Project Coordination



  





**Knowledge/Technical skills** 




 ﻿• Strong understanding of corporate strategy and business operations. 
 



 • Excellent organizational and project management skills. 
 



 • Strong analytical and reporting capabilities. 
 



 • Advanced presentation and report preparation skills. 
 



 • High level of professionalism and confidentiality. 
 



 • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English and Arabic. 
 



 • Strong stakeholder management and coordination skills. 
 



 • Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple priorities. 
 



 • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (PowerPoint, Excel, Word, Outlook). 
 



 • Ability to prepare executive\-level presentations and dashboards.
